cohort: 24,452 children aged 3-6 years in Suzhou, China, with a case-control subset of 3,786 children (1,893 with obesity and 1,893 controls).
finding: The prevalence of overweight and obesity among preschool children in Suzhou is relatively high, increasing with age, and associated with birth history, parental weight status, and unhealthy lifestyle factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with increased risk of obesity in preschool children.
